mentions.name: Curlbro
mentions.description: A free workout app that runs in the browser, offering workout guidance and tracking as a no-cost alternative to paid workout apps in the app stores.
mentions.problem: Existing workout app variants in the app stores are not free; the author also built it after their trainer blew them off.
mentions.source_excerpt: I vibe coded a workout app that lives in the browser and is totally free unlike all the variants in the app store.

evidence.value: I vibe coded a workout app that lives in the browser and is totally free unlike all the variants in the app store.
